1. A system, comprising:
a first software component for use in configuring operation of a second software component via a proxy and stub interface;
a first memory space comprising the first software component, a proxy software component and an activity monitor software component;
a second memory space comprising the second software component and a stub software component; and
at least one processor for executing software components stored on the first and second
memory spaces, wherein the activity monitor software component is arranged when executed to:
monitor a first event associated with the first software component;
monitor a second event associated with the proxy software component;
assess compliance of the first and second events with a schedule of events; and
generate an error message in response to non-compliance with the schedule of events.
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the schedule of events includes timing and/or order of the events.
3. The system of claim 1, further comprising a data store partitioned into the first memory space and the second memory space.
4. The system of claim 1, further comprising a first data store comprising the first memory space and a second data store comprising the second memory space.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein the system is a vehicle system.
6. The system of claim 5, wherein the vehicle system is a cruise control system.
7. The system of claim 5, wherein the second software component comprises a drivetrain component.
8. The system of claim 1, wherein the first software component comprises a logic component arranged to generate a command event to control the second software component based on an input event.
9. The system of claim 8, wherein the input event comprises a sensor reading obtained from a sensor component.
10. The system of claim 9, wherein the sensor component is a speed sensor component.
11. The system of claim 9, wherein the input event is obtained in response to a polling event initiated by the logic component.
12. The system of claim 11. wherein the event associated with the first software component is selected from a list including the input event, the polling event, and the command event.
13. The system of claim 1, further comprising a troubleshooting component arranged to treat an error in response to receiving the error message.
